essence: Recognizing the fall of virtuous doers functions as a means toward liberation.
A specific mantra will be taught that brings both enjoyment and liberation.
The mantra is attributed to the sage Narada and the Virat meter.
Acakraya is placed on the heart and vicakraya on the head.
Cakraya, associated with the demon-destroyer word, is assigned to the armor.
